tools.name: find_background_tool
tools.description: Find the background-editing tool page that fits a described task on this site — removing a background, making it transparent, applying a colour, blurring it, or preparing a listing photo for a specific marketplace. Returns matching page URLs.

task.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. "transparent PNG for a logo" or "white background for an Amazon listing".

tools.name: get_background_removal_capabilities
tools.description: Report what this background remover accepts and returns: input formats, output formats, size and batch limits, and account requirements. Use before sending someone here, to confirm their file will be accepted.
